note: Copy to configs/garment_inference.json (the path in CV_GARMENT_CONFIG) and set CV_GARMENT_ENABLED=true. Models must have been evaluated on a held-out test split (scripts/garment.py evaluate) unless allow_unevaluated is true (development only). Cameras not listed here don't run a garment model when 'cameras' is non-empty; '*' applies to every camera.
